paragraphs.source_en: People in the last camp are wrong, and we’ve found they usually refer to a particular shuttle flight: Mark Lee and Jan Davis were both astronauts slated to ride Space Shuttle Endeavor in 1992. They had fallen in love during training and gotten married on the sly prior to launch. Newlyweds on a Space Shuttle may be the most plausible case for a successful rendezvous and docking, but listen, a shuttle has about as much living space as a school bus, only with a crew of seven, a sealed atmosphere, and no shower. No doubt this is someone’s ideal setting, but if Lee and Davis successfully defiled low Earth orbit, the crew likely would’ve noticed.
